tool.name: SemiBin2 bin
tool.description: Bin contigs using a trained SemiBin2 model
tool.command: SemiBin2 bin \ --input-fasta '$input_fasta' \ --model '$model' \ --output '$output_dir' \ #if $input_bam: --input-bam '$input_bam' #end if #if $input_abundance: --input-abundance '$input_abundance' #end if #if $sequencing_type and str($sequencing_type) != 'None': --sequencing-type '$sequencing_type' #end if #if $prodigal_output_faa: --prodigal-output-faa '$prodigal_output_faa' #end if #if $allow_missing_mmseqs2: --allow-missing-mmseqs2 #end if #if $cannot_name: --cannot-name '$cannot_name' #end if #if $min_contig_len: --min-contig-len '$min_contig_len' #end if #if $recluster: --recluster #end if #if $no_recluster: --no-recluster #end if #if $random_seed: --random-seed '$random_seed' #end if #if $verbose: --verbose #end if #if $quiet: --quiet #end if

param.name: input_bam
param.label: Input BAM file (reads mapped to contigs)

param.name: cannot_name
param.label: Cannot link file name
param.help: Name of the cannot link file

param.name: min_contig_len
param.label: Minimum contig length
param.help: Minimum length of contigs to bin

tool.help:
**What it does**
Bin contigs using a trained SemiBin2 model.
**Changes in v2.5.0**
- Added `hybrid` as a synonym for `long_read` in `--sequencing-type` - Deprecated `--prodigal-output-faa` (no longer used) - Deprecated `--allow-missing-mmseqs2` (no-op)
**Usage**
Bin contigs with a pretrained model:
```bash SemiBin2 bin -i contigs.fasta --model model.zip -b reads.bam -o output ```
For long-read data:
```bash SemiBin2 bin -i contigs.fasta --model model.zip -b reads.bam -o output --sequencing-type long_read ```
**Citation**
Pan S, Zhu C, Zhao XM, Coelho LP. A deep siamese neural network improves metagenome-assembled genomes in microbiome datasets across different environments. *Nature Communications* 2022. DOI: 10.1038/s41467-022-29843-y
Pan S, Zhao XM, Coelho LP. SemiBin2: self-supervised contrastive learning leads to better MAGs for short- and long-read sequencing. *Bioinformatics* 2023. DOI: 10.1093/bioinformatics/btad209
